name: I Can Win It Back (Skeletal Draft)
status_note: Draft shell for co-designers to replace freely. Cost curve test v0.2: 27 cards at Cost 1–2 and 13 at Cost 5–6; no Cost 3–4. Rock Bottom Poker and current support text remain isolated in this lab.
watchpoints: Does 4 bonus Stash break ordinary pacing?
Is resetting to two Stash punishing but recoverable?
Do opponent hands remain relevant without giving opponent Stash?
Does the once-per-Turn poker choice dominate Character play?
How often can both players draw three without exhausting decks?
Do Cost 6 Characters sit in hand too long after losses, despite more poker wins?
